mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task ( task_name, task_type, task_input_type, sandbox_path, project_file_tree, input, output, status, priority, timeout_seconds, input_content, created_by, started_at, result_summary, max_steps, total_steps, error_msg, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{taskInputType}, #{sandboxPath}, #{projectFileTree}, #{input}, #{output}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{timeoutSeconds}, #{inputContent}, #{createdBy}, #{startedAt}, #{resultSummary}, #{maxSteps}, #{totalSteps}, #{errorMsg}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{finishedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' OR status = 'PARSING_ARCHIVE' ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at ASC
